name: Commands
lead: Adds a room's slash commands from a usage line: the `commands` global, or `room.commands`.

functions.name: add
functions.signature: commands.add(usage: string, fn: (player: Player, args: { [string]: any }) -> string ?, opts: CommandOpts ?) → Command
functions.description: usage: "bet <amount:integer 1..10000> [color:red|black]". Types: word, integer, number (with an optional min..max), player, a|b|c, text... (the rest of the line as a string), words... (as a list). args holds each argument by name; an optional one not typed is nil. Return a string and the player reads it in red.
